'''Michael Phelps''' played the [[2008 Match Play Championship]]. Posting as micokeman on the Players Committee forum, he ran monthly Star Wars CCG tournaments on the first Saturday of each month at the Church of Acts in Ambler, Pennsylvania, near Philadelphia: by April 2004 two booster pack tournaments had been held there, with sealed deck and constructed events planned,<ref name="pcf-3153-44737">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=44737#44737 Regular SWCCG Tourny in the Philly area!], Michael Phelps, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 April 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015439/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60270%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> and his January 2005 announcement, for a four-round Swiss constructed event on 5 February 2005, still named him as tournament director.<ref name="pcf-3153-60270">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60270#60270 Regular SWCCG Tourny in the Philly area!], Michael Phelps, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (20 January 2005). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050226015439/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=60270%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
